items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: But that was way up in Ferdinand and Isabella's time.

ctx.x: More Asiatic, or African. See, on account of the Moors that were in there for so many years. And they left their stamp there. Until Le Cid kicked them out of there. But that was way up in Ferdinand and Isabella's time. But the Moors had been there ever since Mohammed's day. Ever since 700.
So that brings -- we have already covered what happened after that.
